description: Questions over the mock org's Knowledge base (4 articles). 'relevant' lists article UrlNames; 'facts' are short phrases a correct answer must contain; unanswerable questions should produce an explicit escalation (abstention). Paraphrased and out-of-scope questions are included on purpose: the lexical retriever is expected to miss some.
